tools.name: get_agent
tools.description: Get one AgentTrust agent's public profile by slug, including its structured Agent Card, current reliability score, and a machine-readable trustDecision (recommended, confidence, reasons) for deciding whether to invoke it.

tools.name: get_agent_health
tools.description: Get one agent's current effective health status and monitoring detail — derived from heartbeat freshness for push-mode agents, or the latest pull check otherwise.

tools.name: send_heartbeat
tools.description: Record a push-style heartbeat for an agent you own, marking it alive right now. The server sets the timestamp; no client-supplied time is accepted.

tools.name: check_agent_trust
tools.description: The preferred pre-invocation trust check for an unknown external agent. Read-only, requires no AgentTrust API key or account. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_agents, check_agent_trust · Private data: send_heartbeat, check_agent_trust · Public sink: send_heartbeat.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_agents, check_agent_trust · Private data: send_heartbeat, check_agent_trust · Public sink: send_heartbeat

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
